profiles.name: David Zhou
profiles.description: I'm really passionate about piano; I've been playing for 12 years now and I don't plan on stopping during my time at Waterloo. I enjoy classical music, but I also like Laufey and NewJeans. My favourite food is Portuguese Boiled Octopus or Francesinha, and my favourite game is Clair-Obscur: Expedition 33.

profiles.name: Harrison Yang
profiles.description: Hi, I’m Harrison. I am in mechanical engineering. I play tennis and basketball. I am actually Taiwanese.

profiles.name: Jacob Lang
profiles.description: I like puzzles and generally all things engineering. I play video games too and have some Rubik's Cube talent. Lowkey down to do most things.

profiles.name: Nikola Blagoev
profiles.description: I love swimming and watching Formula 1. I like playing many sports and board games. I enjoy a variety of TV shows and movies, especially Star Wars and Attack on Titan. I also enjoy online games like Valorant and GTA V. My favorite food is shawarma, and I'm pretty social and enjoy hanging out and doing activities with other people.

profiles.name: Jacob Masters
profiles.description: Hi, my name is Jacob and I'm from the North York area in Toronto. In my free time, I love to play hockey, the piano, and board games, and listen to artists like The Strokes, Daniel Caesar, Mac Miller, and Frank Ocean. I'm excited to learn and grow with all of you and explore all the different fields mechanical engineering has to offer!

profiles.name: Arya Abdi
profiles.description: I love stories in general, but mostly fantasy and science fiction. I love so many indie games (Outer Wilds, Celeste, etc.), and a bunch of movies and shows, animated ones in particular (Arcane, Spiderverse). I love Billie, Willis, Laufey, and Saint Motel as artists. I watched Hadestown recently and want to get into more musicals. I also love Dropout and improv content in general, including DnD. I also love board games and playing piano (except I'm not great at piano and don't have my sheet music with me, so I can't really play anything at Waterloo yet).

profiles.name: Elliot Ng
profiles.description: I enjoy playing video games like Brawl Stars, Marvel Rivals, and Big Walk. I also play Pokémon Go every day. I will play almost any sport as long as it is not competitive.
